server.boundary: application middleware entry to response headers ready; excludes socket ingress and body transfer

boundaries.click: pointer click event timestamp (or click handler entry fallback); excludes pointer-down to release; keyboard/programmatic submit has no click measurement
boundaries.paint: second requestAnimationFrame opportunity; excludes image loading and is not proof of pixels displayed
boundaries.remainder: request-to-JSON duration minus application middleware duration; includes transport, unmeasured ingress, body transfer, parsing and scheduling
boundaries.parallel: parent spans contain children; parallel child durations overlap and must not be added
boundaries.operations: request-wide operation totals are already included in spans; nested or concurrent operations must not be summed; text reads include decoding, not pure disk I/O
